messages.subject: zoom to a region of the plot after log transformation
parts:
Hi,
that works:

library("ggplot2")
df<-data.frame(x=c(1,2,3),y=c(10,100,500))
p<-ggplot(data=df,aes(x=x,y=y))+geom_line()
#p<-p+scale_y_log10()
p<-p+coord_cartesian(ylim = c(20,30))
p

messages.subject: Re: zoom to a region of the plot after log transformation
parts:
Currently, you'll need to manually transform the coord_cartesian limits:

df<-data.frame(x=c(1,2,3),y=c(10,100,500))
p<-ggplot(data=df,aes(x=x,y=y))+geom_line()
p<-p+scale_y_log10()
p<-p+coord_cartesian(ylim = log10(c(20,30)))
p


Hadley
